bindings.statement: Under the declared scalar field interpretation, OMAI PF = sigma_e*S^2 is Physlib ThermoelectricMaterial.powerFactor.
conditions: Use a ThermoelectricMaterial satisfying its field constraints; identify OMAI scalar sigma_e with M.sigma and Seebeck with M.S.
Strict positivity additionally requires S != 0.

conventions.model_scope: Isotropic scalar thermoelectric material in linear response at one shared operating point.
conventions.component_scope: Scalar electronic conductivity and Seebeck; lattice and total conductivity use only an explicitly isotropic diagonal specialization, never arbitrary tensor entries or trace averaging.
conventions.normalization_basis: Intensive bulk transport coefficients, not device conductance.
conventions.unit_embedding: sigma in S/m; S in V/K; kappa in W/(m K); absolute T in K; PF in W/(m K^2); zT dimensionless.
conventions.held_fixed: All coefficients evaluated at the same T, carrier density/doping, composition, and model.
conventions.admissibility: sigma > 0, kappa_l > 0, kappa_e >= 0; coefficients must describe the material.

remaining_obligations: The reviewed scalar formula interpretation and positivity transfer are compiled. Numerical electronic transport producers, finite precision, and physical adequacy are not certified.

bindings.statement: The OMAI scalar electronic transport quantities can supply the sigma, S, and kappa_e fields of a valid Physlib thermoelectric material at the same operating point.
conditions: sigma > 0 and kappa_e >= 0; S may have either sign.

conditions: Valid material gives strictly positive total thermal conductivity.
Positive zT requires T > 0 and S != 0.
Lattice-only monotonicity requires positive replacement kappa_l, ordered lattice coefficients, T >= 0, and all other coefficients fixed.

bindings.statement: OMAI single-mode HelmholtzFreeEnergy is a candidate interpretation of CanonicalEnsemble.helmholtzFreeEnergy once the oscillator model and its closed-form formulas have been proved.
conditions: Construct a canonical ensemble on Nat with counting measure and the stated harmonic spectrum.
Prove finite nonzero Boltzmann measure and integrability of energy for T>0.
Bind n_BE(x)=1/(exp(x)-1), with x=hbar*omega/(kB*T), and positive log argument.

conventions.model_scope: Independent stable quantum harmonic mode at fixed volume, with countably infinite levels E_n=hbar*omega*(n+1/2).
conventions.component_scope: One fixed (q,nu) mode; no mixing of mode-indexed values and extensive ensemble values.
conventions.normalization_basis: One oscillator; counting measure with dof=0 or explicitly equivalent phase-space normalization.
conventions.frequency_convention: Symbolic omega is angular rad/s. Canonical linear THz requires omega=2*pi*10^12*nu_THz, not value identity.
conventions.unit_embedding: Energy in J, entropy/heat capacity in J/K, temperature in K; hbar and kB in consistent SI values.
conventions.held_fixed: Mode spectrum, q weights, and cell volume fixed when differentiating in T.
conventions.admissibility: T>0, omega>0, hbar>0, kB>0; zero/imaginary/unstable modes excluded and not assigned totalized Lean values.
conventions.qpoint_weighting: No q sum at the single-mode stage.

remaining_obligations: Derive the oscillator partition sum and identify the actual OMAI closed form with the named ensemble quantity; the spectrum theorem alone does not identify thermodynamics.

bindings.statement: An OMAI nonnegative absolute-temperature scalar can be wrapped as Physlib Temperature; beta uses the same kB convention.
conditions: T >= 0 for the carrier type; T>0 for inverse-temperature formulas.

conventions.unit_embedding: Kelvin or an explicitly consistent absolute-temperature scale; no Celsius offset.
conventions.admissibility: Nonnegative carrier; strict positivity for beta-based laws.

remaining_obligations: Formalize the OMAI real-value-to-nonnegative-Temperature adapter and unit convention; wrapping a value does not prove a physical model.

bindings.statement: The positive scalar spring oscillator frequency sqrt(k/m) is a restricted model related to harmonic vibrational frequencies; it is not a lattice dynamical-matrix or molecular Hessian identification.
conditions: Single oscillator spring constant k>0 and mass m>0.

conventions.model_scope: One-dimensional positive-mass, positive-spring classical oscillator only.
conventions.component_scope: Scalar oscillator; no mode eigenvector or crystal index identification.
conventions.frequency_convention: Angular omega; linear THz and molecular wavenumber require explicit conversions.

remaining_obligations: Construct the mass-weighted mode or molecular-Hessian interpretation and prove the unit conversion before claiming a formula match.

bindings.statement: Physlib harmonic potential and linear restoring force illustrate a restricted conservative-force model, not OMAI general interatomic potentials or a DFT Hellmann-Feynman theorem.
conditions: Single scalar spring k>0 and mass m>0; no claim for arbitrary atomistic potentials.

conventions.component_scope: One coordinate, not arbitrary atom-indexed force arrays.
conventions.unit_embedding: Consistent energy, length, and force units.
conventions.reference_energy: Potential k*x^2/2 with reference at equilibrium.

remaining_obligations: Prove an atomistic restriction/coordinate interpretation before reusing these declarations as a model-specific OMAI result.

bindings.statement: Physlib Crystal represents periodicity by an additive-group action with a finite fundamental domain; OMAI Structure includes geometric/material content not yet identified.
conditions: Choose the translation group and site equivalence matching the actual structure.

conventions.model_scope: Abstract periodic crystal, not arbitrary nonperiodic/molecular structure.
conventions.unit_embedding: Metric coordinates, cell vectors, and species are extra interpretation data.

remaining_obligations: Construct metric/species/cell identification; do not infer cell volume, atom counts, or electronic operators from abstract periodicity.

bindings.statement: Physlib pressure is minus the volume derivative of Helmholtz free energy; OMAI pressure is a compressive stress trace, so their equality needs a thermodynamic stress interpretation.
conditions: Fixed composition and T, differentiable free energy in volume, compatible mechanical equilibrium and stress convention.

conventions.model_scope: Equilibrium system described by an NVEHamiltonian family.
conventions.component_scope: Scalar pressure; no automatic equality to arbitrary stress components.
conventions.unit_embedding: MicroHamiltonian uses beta=1/T and F=-T log Z; derive physical kB/temperature scaling before SI comparison.
conventions.held_fixed: Temperature and particle/model parameters during V derivative.
conventions.reference_energy: Same free-energy reference and volume family.

remaining_obligations: Prove units and stress/free-energy conjugacy; existing source declaration is not the OMAI contract_pressure theorem.

bindings.statement: Physlib inviscid Cauchy stress is -p*I (tensile-positive); OMAI contract_pressure is +trace(sigma)/3 with compressive-positive sigma. A negation plus static/isotropic specialization is required.
conditions: Dimension 3, isotropic static specialization, and sigma_OMAI=-stress_Physlib.

conventions.model_scope: Inviscid continuum stress, not an atomistic/DFT stress derivation.
conventions.component_scope: Three-dimensional stress tensor; explicit sign conversion.
conventions.unit_embedding: Pressure/stress in Pa after unit alignment.

remaining_obligations: Prove the signed tensor interpretation and trace identity; do not relabel tensile and compressive conventions as exact.
